answer: Noise tokens injected from block hash at the willow: each miner's reward includes hash-derived decoy tokens unpredictable pre-commit. The vertex of the reward distribution shifts per block, so pooling identities yields no measurable variance advantage. A vine of correlated submissions is detected when decoy-token variance across claimed identities falls below the empirical baseline. Break-even: attacker must burn more hash entropy than the reward delta, so farming stays net-negative past roughly 8 identities.
